{{Top|leg}}
'''Musicomp units''' were used to transmit popular [[Music/Legends|music]] into the dance-floor sound systems of nightclubs. These devices were gaudily lit and a common alternative to live [[Band/Legends|band]] performances. Songs could be selected by patrons or programmed by a club's management.
